title: fix(scenarios): door mode mints its token from a 200 { redirect, url } authorize answer
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"hotlong"} -->
_Requested by **Jack** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzS?thread=cmsg_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzSGEL3MyfCvK8gZfN89TKtXi)_

Fixes #37627

## What changes

`mintAuthoringToken` (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/app.ts`) now follows the authorize redirect in either shape the authorization server sends it:

- a 302 with a `Location` (as before), or
- a 200 `{ "redirect": true, "url": "…" }`, whose `url` is followed exactly like a `Location`: to the consent step, then the token exchange.

A redirect (either shape) whose URL carries `error` is now recorded as the refusal of the authorization step, with the OAuth error as its `code`, instead of being posted to the consent endpoint. Any other answer stays the authorization step's refusal, as before.

## Why

On main, `--modes door` stopped at "no token for the draft door … authorization". The cause, measured in `@better-auth/oauth-provider` 1.7.12 (`handleRedirect`): it answers JSON instead of a 302 when the request carries `sec-fetch-mode: cors` or `accept: application/json`, and Node's `fetch` (undici) sends `sec-fetch-mode: cors` on every request. So the runner always got the 200 shape and read an empty `Location`. The card's premise re-measured on `origin/main` 33a31dc7: holds.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/runner/door-token-mint.test.ts test/runner/app.test.ts test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`: 3 files, 184 tests passed. The new file (5 tests) against a loopback authorization server: one test per shape (302 `Location`; 200 `{redirect,url}`, asserting the request carried `sec-fetch-mode: cors`), the error redirect, a 200 naming no redirect, and an unauthenticated authorize (asserts `code` and `status`). Against main's `app.ts` the 200-shape and error-redirect tests fail (2 of 5).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck`: clean.
- Derived gate families (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 63 commands): 62 exit 0 locally. `pnpm check:query-options-erasure` hit my 240 s local timeout and is left to CI (NOT MEASURED locally).
- Acceptance run, no shim, `--packages workspace` on this branch; the blank template already reads `protocol: '^19'` on main, so no scratch-dir workaround for objectstack#37586 was needed:

```
pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios run-scenarios --modes door --only crm_account_with_contacts --packages workspace --model haiku --effort medium --door-skills $PWD/skills

packages: workspace @ 0c149b4b + uncommitted changes (unreleased)
| Build | 37/38 ⚠ degraded |
| Build · author | success · 31/80 turns · 1m 51s · claude-haiku-5-5 · effort medium |
| Seed | 1/8 ⚠ seed: 7 refused |
| Run-问数 | 4/6 · 10 not measured ⚠ 1 leaking |
| Run-operations | 0/0 · 6 not measured |
- door: package `com.scenario.democrm` created · client connected (openid metadata:write) · 7 drafts pending · publish: published, 7 published
- door finding: build: the build denies partner_user the create on democrm_contact that the card gives it (operation contact_bad_email: its probe of the declared write was refused PERMISSION_DENIED (403))
```

("uncommitted changes" at packing time were the test file and the error-redirect branch, both committed since; the token path the run took is the committed one.)

## Acceptance notes

- The Build half completes; the one lost point is the author's grant, a model result, not the runner.
- Seed refused 7 of 8 and the Run half was mostly not measured in this single round. Not investigated here (outside this card's fence); the trial round on 6c290d3a seeded fine, so it may be worth a look by the eval seat.
